description: This file implements an Android media playback service (`MusicService`) that manages media browsing, playback, and media session handling. It provides functionalities such as media queue management, media metadata updates, playback controls, and integration with notifications and Android Auto. The class extends `MediaBrowserService` and interacts with `MediaSession`, `Playback`, and other utility classes to facilitate media playback in an Android app context.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: An Android service that manages media playback, media browsing, and media session lifecycle for a media app, supporting features like queue management, metadata updates, and integration with notifications and Android Auto.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the media session, media provider, playback, and notification manager when the service is created.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to execute commands such as pause, based on the action and extras.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases resources, stops playback, and releases media session when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onGetRoot
methods.description: Determines whether a client is authorized to browse media and returns the root ID for media browsing.

methods.name: onLoadChildren
methods.description: Loads media items for a given parent media ID, either by retrieving or using cached data.

methods.name: loadChildrenImpl
methods.description: Implements the logic to load media items based on the parent media ID.

methods.name: handlePlayRequest
methods.description: Starts playback of the current media item and updates notifications.

methods.name: handlePauseRequest
methods.description: Pauses playback and schedules delayed service stop.

methods.name: handleStopRequest
methods.description: Stops playback, updates state, and schedules delayed service stop.

methods.name: updateMetadata
methods.description: Updates the media metadata and album art in the media session.

methods.name: updatePlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the current playback state with optional error message.

methods.name: setCustomAction
methods.description: Adds custom actions (e.g., favorite) to playback state.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Determines the set of playback actions available based on current state.

methods.name: getCurrentPlayingMusic
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the currently playing music.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked when media playback completes; advances the queue or stops playback.

methods.name: onPlaybackStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback for playback status changes; updates playback state accordingly.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during playback and updates playback state.

methods.name: DelayedStopHandler
methods.description: Inner handler class that stops the service after a delay if playback is inactive.
